note: One build carries both conflicts: Second's data type (text against First's int) and its code list (02 against First's 01). Only the shared 2022 state withholds the conflicting fact and coding; the outer states keep their own.
fails_if: `form_representations` selects one sibling's data type or code list for the shared 2022 state instead of withholding it, or withholds the outer First 2020-2021 (`integer`, 01) or Second 2023-2024 (`text`, 02) facts too

sources.description: Variable 1 (Income): First is pooled 2020-2022 (CVID 100, int, code 01), Second 2022-2024 (CVID 101, text, code 02).
